preceding_paragraph: Table S12 | Hydraulic admissibility screen across the network roster. A junction fails the screen if, under a nominal 50 L s⁻¹ leak added as nodal demand in the day-normal demand state (×1.0 for EXA7 and City D; 0.833 of the feasible peak multiplier for Haining), the time-averaged pressure at the leak junction is negative or any junction's time-averaged pressure changes by more than 5 m per L s⁻¹ (250 m); every excluded junction failed the pressure criterion (9 on City D and 6 on Haining also failed the response criterion). The feasible peak multiplier μ* is the largest multiplier on a 0.05 grid (≤ 1.2) for which the minimum baseline pressure over all junctions and times is non-negative. EXA6 has a negative minimum baseline pressure at ×1.2 (−3148.3 m) and was not evaluated. EXA7 uses its fixed 30-sensor reference configuration (two per partition); the 8% placement rule of Supplementary Note 1.8 applies to City D and Haining. The EXA7 reference corpus of Table S2 was retained unscreened (three of its 30 leak junctions, 82, 84 and 94, fail the screen); the allocation tensor of Table S3 used the 350 admissible EXA7 junctions.
